summary.text: Dave Wallace, a Republican from Leachville, represents Arkansas Senate District 19, which includes all of Mississippi County and parts of Craighead and Poinsett counties.

paragraphs.text: He was elected to the Senate in 2016 and sworn in on the first day of the 2017 session, after serving two years in the Arkansas House of Representatives beginning in 2015.

Wallace was commissioned a second lieutenant through ROTC in 1970 and led troops for more than 20 years; the legislature's profile says he flew Cobra attack helicopters in the Vietnam War and received the Bronze Star and the Legion of Merit.

He is a small business owner whose company specializes in disaster relief, and he attended Arkansas State University and Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University, where he received a business administration degree.
